response.sql:
WITH grouped_by_funding AS (
  SELECT 
    COALESCE(p.fundflux, 'NULL') as funding_source,
    AVG(CASE WHEN ss.boxy IS NOT NULL AND ss.boxz IS NOT NULL AND ss.boxz != 0 
             THEN ss.boxy / ss.boxz END) as avg_ratio,
    COUNT(*) as record_count
  FROM scanspatial ss
  JOIN projects p ON ss.arcref = p.arcregistry
  GROUP BY COALESCE(p.fundflux, 'NULL')
),
cross_source_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(record_count) as avg_count FROM grouped_by_funding
),
filtered_sources AS (
  SELECT 
    gbf.avg_ratio,
    gbf.record_count,
    csa.avg_count
  FROM grouped_by_funding gbf
  CROSS JOIN cross_source_avg csa
  WHERE gbf.record_count > csa.avg_count
)
SELECT 
  AVG(avg_ratio) as avg_ratio,
  SUM(record_count) as total_records,
  AVG(record_count - avg_count) as avg_excess
FROM filtered_sources;

assumptions.assumption: When computing the average ratio (boxy/boxz) for each funding source, 'ignoring missing values' applies only to the ratio calculation. The record count includes all spatial records in that funding source, not just those with computable ratios.
Division by zero (boxz = 0) is treated as an undefined ratio, excluded from the average like NULL values.
NULL funding sources are represented as the string literal 'NULL' in grouping to allow them to form a distinct group.
'Above the average' means strictly greater than (>), not greater than or equal to.

alternatives.interpretation: The phrase 'ignoring missing values' applies to both the ratio calculation and the record count. The record count should include only spatial records where boxy and boxz are both non-NULL (and boxz ≠ 0), not all records in the funding source.

  SELECT 
    COALESCE(p.fundflux, 'NULL') as funding_source,
    AVG(CASE WHEN ss.boxy IS NOT NULL AND ss.boxz IS NOT NULL AND ss.boxz != 0 
             THEN ss.boxy / ss.boxz END) as avg_ratio,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN ss.boxy IS NOT NULL AND ss.boxz IS NOT NULL AND ss.boxz != 0 
               THEN 1 END) as record_count
  FROM scanspatial ss
  JOIN projects p ON ss.arcref = p.arcregistry
  GROUP BY COALESCE(p.fundflux, 'NULL')

cross_source_avg AS (

),

  SELECT 
    gbf.avg_ratio,
    gbf.record_count,
    csa.avg_count
  FROM grouped_by_funding gbf
  CROSS JOIN cross_source_avg csa
  WHERE gbf.record_count > csa.avg_count
)
SELECT 
  AVG(avg_ratio) as avg_ratio,
  SUM(record_count) as total_records,
  AVG(record_count - avg_count) as avg_excess
FROM filtered_sources;
